text:
Fenton Cooperative quotes 45 per unit, delivers in 16 days, and holds a rating of 7 out of 10. It packs in recycled crates.

Torwell Outfitters quotes 80 per unit, delivers in 19 days, and holds a rating of 6 out of 10. It has traded for many years.

Nevwell Cooperative quotes 165 per unit, delivers in 10 days, and holds a rating of 6 out of 10. It prefers orders by post.

Selhurst Outfitters quotes 125 per unit, delivers in 4 days, and holds a rating of 8 out of 10. It has traded for many years.

Which supplier quotes at most 145 per unit, delivers within 5 days and is rated at least 7 out of 10?

HELOMI-BINUNU
